headline: NVDA新增治理风险，财务影响尚未量化
facts: NVIDIA official statement dated November8 confirms independent board investigation and outside independent counsel.
Board states it currently has no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised and expresses confidence in current leadership.
judgment: 新增治理与关键管理人不确定性；声明未量化订单、营收、现金流或监管处罚影响，暂不机械下调盈利模型或以旧价格判抄底。
counterevidence: 董事会仍支持管理层，且当前无理由认为秘密泄露；独立调查不等于已发现违法或财务损失。
next: 董事会调查进展、是否出现SEC或监管正式披露、管理层连续性及11月17日财报；只在订单/限制/经营发生实质变化后重估。
scope_limit: Only independent-board-investigation facts; do not republish unrelated private or unverified allegations.
